items.title: Harrison Barnes Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: That was probably by the name of Chester, I believe. He was the bestest they had on that.

ctx.x: That's true, yeah. Then they tried, started with this. Some fellows used to put, the hand gets sold, they used to put tape on it. All that started right here in New Orleans. They didn't hear of it or, that's where they started. That's where the rhythms started coming in. There was double timing on it. You see, before they used to whoop, whoop, whoop, whoop, whoop, what did they cut that out? And they start that. And this other fellow used to start doubling time with the back of the bow, you see. That was probably…
